title: Build cluster models
action: Construct two embedded cluster models for spinel Li1.33Mn1.67O4: a tetrahedral‑site cluster (Li5Mn12O40)^{27-} and an octahedral‑site cluster (Li7Mn18O38)^{3}. Cut the clusters from the lattice (space group Fd‑3m, a=8.19 Å) and surround them with a Madelung potential generated by point charges at external atomic positions.

title: Electronic structure calculation
action: Run a self‑consistent field calculation for each cluster model using an open‑source quantum chemistry or density functional theory code with a reasonable basis set and exchange‑correlation functional. Converge the wavefunction and electron density.

title: Mulliken population analysis
action: Perform Mulliken (or Löwdin) population analysis on the converged wavefunction for each cluster. Compute the average net charges of lithium at tetrahedral and octahedral sites and write the results to a JSON file.
description: JSON file containing the average net charge of tetrahedral lithium and octahedral lithium.
